title: Cloud Climber
description: Bounce a kitten up an endless sky tower — from sunny rooftops to the stars. Climb today's shared daily tower and race everyone on the online leaderboard. / 帮小猫一路弹跳，从屋顶爬到星空，挑战今日同一座塔并登上在线排行榜。

defaultCaptions.x: My kitten just bounced into the stars in Cloud Climber! Can you climb higher on today's tower?
defaultCaptions.facebook: Cloud Climber: a cozy hand-drawn endless climb. Everyone gets the same tower each day — how high can you go?
defaultCaptions.reddit: Cloud Climber — a hand-drawn endless bouncing climber with a shared daily tower and online leaderboard
defaultCaptions.discord: Daily tower challenge in Cloud Climber — post your height!
